items.t: Bumble earnings take back seat to $1.3 billion Ithaca buyout, says UBS
items.sum: Bumble Inc (NASDAQ:BMBL), the online dating platform operator, reported weaker-than-expected third-quarter revenue, although stronger cost control helped it beat market forecasts for profitability. Revenue fell 15.9% year on year to US$207.1 million, below the analyst consensus of US$209.1...

Online dating app Bumble (NASDAQ:BMBL) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue falling 15.9% year on year to $207.1 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.15 per share was 33.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.t: The Estée Lauder Companies 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to Be Held on November 17, 2026
items.sum: NEW YORK, November 10, 2026--The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) will hold its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders virtually on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 beginning at 9:00 a.m. (ET). Those wishing to access the webcast can visit: www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/EL2026.

items.t: ‘Sugar Daddies Are Us’: Ramsey to 50-Year-Old With $600K Begging for a Dating App
items.sum: A 50-year-old with $600,000 in retirement savings asked Dave Ramsey to build him a dating app, and Ramsey refused. The real drama sits in a quieter question about his house and the 50% of his paycheck he keeps locking away.
